scope: Native validation foundation for the offline paired-reference limiter release assistant. No learned model implemented or adoption claimed in this checkpoint.
profile: Native hard limiting, fully wet; explicit threshold/release/lookahead/link and supported ISP/oversampling controls. Reject clamped/out-of-range and unknown controls.
ceiling_check: All emitted float32 samples including full drain <= 10**(threshold_db/20)+2e-6. This is not an independent continuous-time or ISP measurement.
alignment: Retain raw native prefix and complete public finite drain. Python returns exactly input_frames after removing latency_samples and records the additional filter tail in metadata.
allocation: Native process, begin_drain, and drain each guarded by sotf_host assert_no_allocs. Offline I/O/vector growth outside guards.
validation: Six native integration tests, synthetic deterministic markers/noise/steps only; 44.1/48/96/192 kHz, 1/2/6 channels; partial callbacks; 1x/2x/4x oversampling; short streams; ISP mode; channel link; dual release; zero lookahead; invalid requests.
initial_failures: Initial Python suite rejected a valid zero-output incomplete oversampled drain. Renderer corrected to call begin_drain and use drain_call_bound; full oversampled filter tail can exceed algorithmic latency. Initial lint/format failures corrected; original logs retained.

renderer.rebuild_note: Full cargo test rebuilt the QA executable with its test-build dependency feature graph. Sources unchanged. Final integration suite rerun against this digest.
